QuestionText:
Research report from November
Re your November report ''Antisemitism in Australia Findings of research commissioned by Australia's Special Envoy to Combat Antisemitism''
Who undertook this research?
Assuming it wasn't in house, what was the value of the contract?
Was this done via an open or limited tender?
Were all relevant procedures and processes for procurement followed (including management of any conflict of interests)?
We note that in conflict of interest forms you have referred to a procurement project ''''a nationwide survey'''', and declared a redacted conflict of interest - why was this redacted?
BroadTopic: Anti semitism envoy - Research report from November
